- Tue 26 May, 10:00-11:15
- Wed 27 May, 14:00-15:15
- Thu 28 May, 09:00-10:15

Agenda (draft) - attached as PDF: redwood_tech_agenda.pdf
1) Intros & objectives (5-10m)
2) Architecture & data flow review (15-20m)
3) Model serving / latency/cost tradeoffs (15-20m)
4) Security, network, and deployment options (15-20m)
5) Action items & next steps (10m)

Can you confirm which of the suggested slots works and who from your side will join? Also, if there are specific infra diagrams or compliance docs you want us to review ahead of time, please share. I attached a quick requirements sheet to help the team prepare.

Calendly (if easier): https://calendly.com/camila-reyes/60min

Thanks - happy to adjust the agenda to cover anything specific your ML/infra teams want to prioritize.
